none: PAS NMS-74185A: Roman sword belt fitting
contea di ritrovamento: Norfolk (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman copper alloy openwork sword belt fitting, a circular baldric fastener or phalera with an integral D-shaped loop on the reverse. A small part of the edge is missing. S-shaped and trumpet-like motifs surround an urn on a triangular aperture. The vessel is narrow-necked with a pedestal base, and its body is engraved with vertical lines.
